headline: Board approved park and field permits for youth sports, cricket leagues, cookouts, and a poetry reading; continued a food pantry proposal to September.
summary: The Lowell Board of Parks approved numerous field and park use requests for groups including LPD Flag Football, UML English Department, Lowell Girls Field Hockey, Lowell Pop Warner, cricket leagues, and several private events. A proposal for a community food pantry at Kerouac Park Greenspace was continued to the September meeting, and several other requests had no vote because no one appeared to present them.
decisions: Approved Scullin Park Greenspace/Reilly School field use for LPD Flag Football, 3-0.
Approved Campbell Senior League Baseball Field/Gage Park Whalen field use for LPD Flag Football, 3-0.
Approved Kerouac Park Greenspace poetry reading for Emmet Moriarty/UML English Department for a fee of $225, 3-0.
No vote taken on Tenesha Scarlett's South Common Stage church service request because no one attended.
No vote taken on Tenesha Scarlett's Shedd Park Pavilion church service request because no one attended.
Continued Alex Merkel's Kerouac Park Greenspace community food pantry proposal to the September meeting, 3-0.
Approved Jasmine Galarza's Hovey Field birthday party request as written, 3-0.
Approved removing fees for Lowell Girls Field Hockey's canceled August practice dates and the week of August 24th, 3-0.
Approved adjusting Lowell Girls Field Hockey's game schedule and giving credit for hours not needed, 3-0.
Lowell Pop Warner's Cawley Memorial Stadium Complex request was not addressed; the area is no longer needed.
No vote taken on Ruth Jeune's Shedd Park Pavilion birthday party request because no one attended.
Approved Robbie Barnes' Lowell Catholic Walk-A-Thon at Callery Park fields as written, 3-0.
Approved William Faranda's SLS Fitness Field Day at Shedd Park as written, 3-0.
Approved Joseph Ngugi's revised cookout date of September 26 for $75, 3-0.
Approved Felicita Espinal's International Softball Cup event at North Common as written, 3-0.
No vote taken on Angie Perez's Shedd Park Pavilion birthday party request because no one attended.
Approved Rothanak Sarath's Free Comic Book and Back 2 School Giveaway at Clemente Park as written, 3-0.
Approved Christian Guillermo's kickball league at North Common as written, 3-0.
No vote taken on John Riel's Kitteredge Park gender reveal request because no one attended.
Approved Hetal Patel's Adult Cricket schedule at Hovey Field as written, 3-0.
Approved Sabeeh Ehsan's Adult Cricket dates for September 5-6 as written, 3-0.
Approved Sabeeh Ehsan's Adult Cricket dates in September and October as written, 3-0.
Approved Sabeeh Ehsan's Adult Cricket Sunday dates in September and October as written, 3-0.
Approved canceling the November and December Board meetings and holding special meetings as needed, 3-0.
Approved Maria Claudio's Clemente Baseball League dates at North Common pending availability, 3-0.

Kerouac Park Greenspace  
Interested in establishing a small community food pantry in downtown Lowell! I live 
 nearby and could maintain the pantry, and it's a medium traffic area where it's  
 accessible, but out-of-the-way enough to minimize any potential vandalism or misuse.   
The pantry would be a free, volunteer-maintained resource containing shelf-stable, 
 commercially packaged food items that community members can take when needed or 
 contribute to when able. The goal is to provide a simple, accessible source of food 
 assistance for residents and visitors experiencing food insecurity.
